{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican majority ended the practice of earmarks, which often diverted transportation spending to politically favored projects.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans secured the longest reauthorization of the Highway Trust Fund in a decade in the current Congress.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans are advancing a comprehensive reform of the Federal Aviation Administration to make flying easier and more secure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration subordinates civil engineering to social engineering as it pursues an exclusively urban vision of dense housing and government transit.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's Livability Initiative is meant to coerce people out of their cars.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congress once imposed by fiat a single maximum speed limit for the entire nation, from Manhattan to Montana.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 1980 Republican Platform pledged to repeal the single maximum speed limit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"After the election of Ronald Reagan, the single maximum speed limit was repealed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The platform pledges to address current problems in transportation policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The platform proposes to remove from the Highway Trust Fund programs that should not be the business of the federal government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
